title: The Boy Raised by Wolves: A True Story of Feral Survival
actual_content_summary: The story of Kamala, a six-year-old boy found living with wolves in India in 1972, explores the boundaries of human nature and the effects of environment on behavior. Kamala's unique case, where he was raised by wolves and later struggled to adapt to human society, raises questions about the role of primal instincts in shaping human behavior. Through his story, psychologist Dr. Sukumar Singh examines the complexities of human adaptation and the blurred lines between human and animal behavior.
